# tosijs-pattern

> Matching that reads like what it means: a fluent, declarative alternative to regular expressions.

Version 0.1.0.

- Docs: https://pattern.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-pattern
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-pattern

Each link below is the page's markdown. Drop `index.md` from it for the HTML page, where the examples run.
The whole corpus, as one markdown file: https://pattern.tosijs.net/llms-full.txt

Live examples run inline on the shared page by default (not sandboxed):
each has its own `preview` element, but they share one tosijs module, so
`tosi()` state singletons are shared across every example on a page. This is
deliberate (it shows tosi isolation and lets you drive demos via the global
singleton). Namespace example state with unique top-level keys so examples
don't clobber each other; the `iframe` attribute isolates DOM/CSS, not state.

## Docs

- [tosijs-pattern](https://pattern.tosijs.net/index.md): Matching that reads like what it means: a fluent, declarative alternative to regular expressions, with no backtracking and a step budget.

## Guide

- [Guide](https://pattern.tosijs.net/guide/index.md): Using tosijs-pattern: the vocabulary, and turning existing regexes into patterns.
- [Vocabulary](https://pattern.tosijs.net/vocabulary/index.md): Every noun and verb in tosijs-pattern, what each matches, and the values and captures a pattern gives back.
- [From regex](https://pattern.tosijs.net/from-regex/index.md): fromRegex(): translate a regex into an equivalent pattern where that is provable, or refuse it with the reason. With the numbers over real code.

## Design

- [Design](https://pattern.tosijs.net/design/index.md): Why tosijs-pattern works the way it does: its speed, and the plan for a formal specification.
- [Performance](https://pattern.tosijs.net/performance/index.md): How fast tosijs-pattern is against native regex and a linear regex engine, why, and the plan to close the gap.
- [A formal specification in Lean 4](https://pattern.tosijs.net/formal/index.md): A proposed Lean 4 specification of Pattern: the properties worth proving, and how the TypeScript engine is tested against it.
